generation.scope: A reduced regular finite window admits no nonidentity binary quartic Bezout root, without restrictions on cofactor components, rank-one fibers or the determinant. Integral determinant octics have exactly nine or ten independent cofactors. Any five-by-five linear symmetroid whose corank-two scheme is the twenty marks also forces equivalent opposite configurations, even for multiple quintic factors.
